newsitem.title: UK: Police officers reported wounded in N.Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Police officers reported wounded in N.Ireland.

text.p: Security sources in Northern Ireland said on Monday that two police officers had been shot and seriously wounded in the town of Lurgan.
The sources said that the incident happened just before 1100 GMT. It was thought that the victims were in a serious condition, they said.
"Two people have been injured," a spokeswoman for the Royal Ulster Constabulary said.
The British province has been tense for months after Irish Republican Army guerrillas abandoned a ceasefire and resumed attacks on security forces.
Pro-British Loyalist guerrillas have launched a series of retaliatory attacks on nationalists in the past year, killing two Catholics.
No group admitted responsibility for the shooting in Lurgan, south-west of Belfast.
